'''Zeldiis''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Zel]] in the [[Zel system|Zeltros system]], located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim Territories]]. Zeldiis was a barren rock with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="WZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Zel system]], except [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], were designed for the article [[Zeltros: Pleasure Planet]] on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, compiled by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[January 5]], [[2004]].<ref name="WZ" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Zeltros star system in grid square O-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
